description: Which employers have jobs for former teachers on Exit Ticket (https://exitticketjobs.com) and how many open listings each has, optionally for one US state. Names and counts only: no titles, pay or links to listings. Data is re-read from employers' own career sites (Workday, Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby) when the board is rebuilt; each result gives data_updated_at.

state.description: A US state as a 2-letter code ("TX") or full name ("Texas"), any case. Matches listings that name the state, plus remote listings open across the US.

name: employer_counts
title: Employers hiring teachers
